notes.title: Robot Lord Rising - Update #2
notes.content:
Hey Robot Lovers,

This is a retrospective dev log, the actual feature was implemented back in May.
I'm reworking the enemy AI system from the ground up. The previous AI system was very basic and very predictable, the new system will be more flexible, provide more gameplay variation and be more fun to play against.

Designing a system that would allow AI characters to use cards of very different types (attack cards, buff cards, movement cards, etc.), all in one system, took a lot of planning. I basically designed the whole system and outlined all interactions with existing code on paper first, before writing any code. This really paid off in the end, since I could solve problems and identify complications in short iterations, requiring much fewer changes and rewrites later on during coding.

A challenge when creating the AI system in any game is always to make it smart enough to be a challenge for the player, but dumb enough to be beatable and to not feel unfair. Limiting the information that the AI bases its decisions on, and adding an adjustable way for the AI to make mistakes and inaccurate judgments are a good start to make the AI smart but fair.


This new system will allow the AI to use a greater variety of cards, but also to use those cards in a more varied order. The AI will also use its cards in more specific situations, such as only using a healing card when a nearby ally has taken damage. Lastly, the AI will have adjustable intelligence levels, allowing level designers better control over the difficulty of each level.

The new AI will provide a bigger challenge to players, will keep players on their feet throughout repeated gameplay, and will allow game and level designers to design a more creative and more enjoyable gameplay experience.

/Jakob - Lead Programmer

notes.title: Robot Lord Rising Build Notes (0.2.2).
notes.content:
Time for another robotastic build update list. Are you ready?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212284/7fb91663370b542ecd11ebb92e90ee567986f009.jpg[/img]

[h2]Build Notes (0.2.2) [/h2]

[b]New and shiny[/b]
- Energize your play style with the new Battery Pack trinket!
- Enjoy tranquil waterfalls and challenging gameplay in a new variant of the concept level, with two beacons to protect!
- Fresh B(e)acon model is here! Protect it from the robots!
- Another round of whitebox assets added, vegetation!

[b]C..c....changes[/b]
- Card balance update! Card values have been changed and cards will appear in different rates in the draft.
- Teleport card logic has been reworked to be more intuitive and consistent:
    - Characters can now teleport over gaps, water, blocks and terrain pieces.
    - If the teleport destination is blocked by an object or another character, the teleporting character will instead appear in the closest empty spot.
    - It is now possible to teleport onto pickups (health, resistance and cards) and mines.
- Trinkets now appear in "regular" draft rounds, together with the cards, instead of appearing on specific rounds.
- Previous round of whitebox assets have been updated.
- Water feels more watery.
- Less beveled dirt, chiseled dirt and lava cubes.
- Loading screen now uses a more up-to-date logo.

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Objects and characters can now be spawned/placed on pickups and mines.
- Fixed a bug where enhancing a long-lasting card during its effect (ex. stance cards) could lead to incorrect card values.
- Small performance optimizations in some cards and trinkets.



[i]Ha det sa bra![/i]

[h2]Don't forget to join our [url=https://limitbreakstudio.com/discord]discord[/url][/h2]

notes.title: Robot Lord Rising Build Notes (0.2.0)
notes.content:
Happy May month to everyone. Robot fiends never rest and neither do we when it comes to sharing exciting build updates. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212284/f1318cdb30a4be2ce39747da8a121d410ab30f5e.png[/img]

[h2]Build Notes (0.2.0) [/h2]

[b]New and shiny[/b]
- Protect the Beacon in a new level focused on defending a position from attacking robots!
- View the game world from a new perspective with some experimental camera tilting. Feedback greatly appreciated!

[b]Changes[/b]
- Players now lose when a single player dies, instead of when all players have died. With the exception of the new beacon protect level
- The round timer instantly ends if all players have played all of their cards (or have pressed the ready button)
- The camera angle while selecting cards has been slightly altered. Feedback greatly appreciated
- Cards now wait until the camera has moved to view the character before they start executing
- Wave attacks are displayed in a wave-like fashion, instead of instantly appearing everywhere at once
- The "Wall" card now increases health of the spawned wall based on card enhancement

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Cards that select a specific tile within a radius now display the range in the card pattern
- The "Most friendly damage" and "Killed by friends" awards no longer count damage to oneself as friendly damage
- The "Shockwave" card now deals a single instance of damage to the boss, instead of up to four
- Nika no longer gets enhance stats on the end screen from her passive ability

[i]Ha det sa bra![/i]

[h2]WISHLIST TODAY[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1420120/Robot_Lord_Rising/

notes.title: Robot Lord Rising Developer Notes 25/02/21
notes.content:
Hello or 0110100001100101011011000110110001101111 to our robotic brethren!

Robot Lord Rising is currently being developed and we have a lot of cool features that you'll be able to test out during different live beats. 

[h2]Ok so what is this game?[/h2]
BIG ANGRY ROBOTS, BIG SWORDS, EXPLOSIONS AND TACTICAL MAYHEM!

Or in other words Robot Lord Rising is a co-op arena battle game that can be played solo or with up to 4 friends online or from the comfort of your couch. Or chairs, we don't judge. 

Pick a hero from a line of lovable and intriguing characters. Program them with action cards of which there are many. You have 30 seconds to choose your tactics and then the maniacal battle bashing party begins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39212284/9ed2ee17540cdcd4daf1a8dd62136bbb2675c896.jpg[/img]

This is the first update on what's going on behind the scenes with latest iterations of the build.

[h2]
Build Notes (0.1.4) 22nd FEB 2020[/h2]
- Added new healing card to minions
- Added size indicators for players and enemies
- Boss cards now show text
- Fixed card description text sometimes being aligned to the wrong side
- Fixed Nika not displaying status effect icons
- Bug fixes for level loading
- Easier to place player start position in "level editor"

[h2]
Build Notes (0.1.3) 12th FEB 2020[/h2]

New and shiny
- New Dozer visual effects
- New environment assets
- New battle music
- New design for in-game cards, card selection and timer

Changes
- Removed deck preview screen
- Four new card backgrounds
- Boss scales HP with number of players
- Testing shorter delay between cards during execution
- Dozer animation tweaks

Fixes
- Fixed multiple bugs when connecting and disconnecting controllers
- Fixed Dozer not having an outline
- Fixed "Play again" button resulting in a soft lock
- Fixed music transition bug
- Fixed tree asset outline

Follow us for more build updates, game-play reveals, artwork and special treats!
